name: Staged deletions are included and acceptance works in a linked Git worktree
description: Staged deletions are included and acceptance works in a linked Git worktree.

passage.quote: The selected content starts from the current Git base with the chosen working-file changes applied. Files are selected as whole files. A temporary index is used to build this tree, leaving the user’s staging area intact. For example, selecting one source file and its description does not silently include an unrelated working edit in another file. Checks must have examined that selected content, including any dependencies that would affect their execution. Git operations explicitly target the selected repository instead of inheriting another repository from the caller’s Git environment.
